map.由每期付款、利率与期数求期初年金终值 使用指南: Annuity-Due Future Value from Payment, Rate and Periods User Guide
map.输入每期付款 PMT、每期利率 r 与期数 n，按期初年金公式计算终值 FV，用: Enter payment per period PMT, periodic rate r and number of periods n, and compute the future value FV with the annuity-due formula, for returns on advance annuities, rent and similar.
map.FV=PMT×[(1+r)^n−1]÷r×(1+r)，期初年金每笔付款多赚一期利: FV = PMT x [(1+r)^n - 1]/r x (1+r); in an annuity-due each payment earns one extra period of interest, so the future value equals an ordinary annuity with the same parameters x (1+r). Applicable to rent, insurance premiums and other beginning-of-period payment streams.
map.租金、保险等「期初付款」现金流的到期积累额。: Maturity accumulation of 'beginning-of-period payment' cash flows such as rent and insurance.
map.每月月初定投的到期本息测算。: Maturity principal and interest estimation for investing at the start of each month.
map.对比期初年金与期末年金终值差异。: Compare the future values of an annuity-due and an ordinary annuity.
map.每期 1,000、月利率 0.5%、12 期期初年金: 1,000 per period, monthly rate 0.5%, 12 periods, annuity-due
map.：FV=PMT×[(1+r)^n−1]÷r×(1+r)=1,000×[(1.00: : FV = PMT x [(1+r)^n - 1]/r x (1+r) = 1,000 x [(1.005^12 - 1)/0.005] x 1.005 = 1,000 x [0.061678/0.005] x 1.005 = 1,000 x 12.3356 x 1.005, about 12,397 CNY. One more period of interest than an ordinary annuity.
map.由首期现金流、增长率与贴现率求现值: Present value from first cash flow, growth rate and discount rate
map.由贷款额、利率与月供反推还款期数: Number of payments from loan amount, interest rate and monthly payment
map.由贷款额与抵押物价值求 LTV: LTV from loan amount and collateral value
map.期初年金和期末年金差多少？: How much difference is there between an annuity-due and an ordinary annuity?
map.期初年金每笔付款多赚一期利息，终值=期末年金×(1+r)。长期定投差距会随期数放: In an annuity-due each payment earns one extra period of interest, so the future value = ordinary annuity x (1+r). With long-term regular investing the gap widens with the number of periods.
map.房租、保费、养老金缴费等多在期初支付，属期初年金；工资、利息多在期末，属普通年金: Rent, insurance premiums and pension contributions are mostly paid at the beginning of the period and are annuities-due, while wages and interest are mostly at the end of the period and are ordinary annuities.
